\expandafter\long\expandafter\def\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname#1#2{%
  \special{dvisvgm:raw <g data-tikzjax-unicode="#1">}%
  #2%
  \special{dvisvgm:raw </g>}%
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=8mm,
  startstop/.style={rectangle, rounded corners, fill=blue!20, draw},
  process/.style={rectangle, draw, fill=orange!20},
  decision/.style={diamond, aspect=2, draw, fill=green!20},
  arrow/.style={-{Stealth[length=3mm]}, thick}]

\node[startstop] (start) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{0}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};
\node[process, below=of start] (read) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{1}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};
\node[decision, below=of read] (cond) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{2}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};
\node[process, below left=12mm and 8mm of cond] (yes) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{3}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};
\node[process, below right=12mm and 8mm of cond] (no) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{4}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};
\node[startstop, below=20mm of cond] (end) {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{5}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}\hbox to1em{M\hss}}};

\draw[arrow] (start) -- (read);
\draw[arrow] (read) -- (cond);
\draw[arrow] (cond) -| node[above,pos=0.75] {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{6}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}}} (yes);
\draw[arrow] (cond) -| node[above,pos=0.75] {\csname tikzjaxUnicodeBridge\endcsname{7}{\hbox to1em{M\hss}}} (no);
\draw[arrow] (yes) |- (end);
\draw[arrow] (no)  |- (end);
\end{tikzpicture}
